canonical_term: Lancaster County Board of Equalization v. Moser
summary: Nebraska Supreme Court decision addressing the high burden for an equalization claim based on comparison to another property's erroneous undervaluation.
plain_language: Pointing to one neighbor's mistake is usually not enough; the taxpayer must prove a grossly excessive value caused by intentional conduct or failure of a plain legal duty, not a mere judgment error.

facts.object: systematic intentional/failure-of-duty error from mere error of judgment

relationships.note: Defines evidentiary burden for equalization relief.
Relevant to evidence quality in protest hearing.

source_refs.citation: Lancaster Cty. Bd. of Equal. v. Moser, 312 Neb. 757 (2022).
